出版者的话

古希腊圣哲亚里士多德曾说：“任何人都会生气，这没什么难的，但若要适时适所地以适当方式对适当对象恰如其分地生气，可就难上加难了。”我们现在讲的情绪管理指的就是要适时适所地，对适当对象恰如其分地表达情绪。

现实生活中，人们越来越多地认识到情绪管理能力的重要性，因为这方面能力出众的人往往在各个领域都游刃有余；相反，此项能力差的人，虽然可能很聪明，但做起事来往往很吃力。

情绪管理能力虽部分得益于先天因素，但归根结底还得靠后天的学习和培养。幼儿时期是情绪管理能力培养的黄金时期，一个人在幼儿时期所获得的情绪经验和习惯会在大脑中形成永久的神经联结，对其身心发展影响很长远。

当前，亲子共读情绪管理类图画书这种情绪管理能力培养方式已被广泛认可。优质的图画书好比幸福的种子，通过父母的声音飞进孩子的耳朵里，植根在孩子的心底，施以阳光、雨露，就能生根、发芽。

这套有趣的动物图画故事书温情脉脉，每一本都是有针对性地就孩子的某一种情绪话题展开，描绘孩子的心路历程，揭示其走出情绪困扰并解决问题的过程。每一本书都附有幼教专家精心撰写的导读，可作为家长亲子共读时的参考。

让我们在这套书的陪伴下，去享受一段美妙的亲子阅读之旅吧

Publisher's Note

The ancient Greek philosopher Aristotle once said: 'Everyone gets angry; that's not difficult. But to get angry at the right time, in the right place, with the right person, and in the right way—well, that's much harder.' What we now call emotional management is precisely about expressing emotions appropriately, at the right time and place, and toward the right person.

In real life, people are increasingly recognizing the importance of emotional management skills. Those who excel in this area often thrive in various fields; conversely, those who lack this skill, though perhaps intelligent, often struggle in their endeavors.

While emotional management skills may partly stem from innate factors, they ultimately rely on learning and cultivation over time. Early childhood is the golden period for developing emotional management skills. The emotional experiences and habits formed during this stage create lasting neural connections in the brain, profoundly influencing a child's physical and mental development.

Currently, parent-child reading of emotional management picture books is widely recognized as an effective way to cultivate emotional skills. High-quality picture books are like seeds of happiness, carried into children's ears by parents' voices, taking root in their hearts, and with sunlight and rain, they can grow and flourish.

This series of heartwarming animal storybooks addresses specific emotional topics for children, illustrating their emotional journeys and revealing how they overcome emotional challenges and solve problems. Each book includes a carefully written guide by early childhood education experts, serving as a valuable reference for parents during shared reading.

Let us enjoy a wonderful parent-child reading journey together with this series.

老师对你说
孩子，其实你不必说谎
我们常说，童心世界是一个真善美的世界，但实际上，孩子的世界也有谎言。不同的是，孩子的谎言与成人的谎言有很大区别。在探讨这种区别之前，让我们先读读这篇关于“谎言”的童话故事吧！
小狗皮波觉得自己的生活太平淡了，他不停地想象各种各样的事情，还把这些想象出来的事情当成真事讲给大家听：星期一，皮波说自己是一个有名的歌手；星期二，皮波声称自己是一个大侦探；星期三，皮波说自己跟国王一样富有；星期四，皮波发誓说自己是一个超级大英雄。皮波的谎话越讲越离谱，同学们终于忍无可忍了，便设计了一个“圈套”。
小斑鸠戴尔芬、小兔提姆和小猫查理都假装遇到困难，请皮波来帮忙。面对让他无能为力的“圈套”，皮波忍不住哭了起来，不得不坦白自己确实说谎了，但只不过是为了让大家更喜欢自己而已。通过这件事，皮波明白了一个道理：朋友们喜爱他真实的样子，他根本不需要编造那些谎话。
孩子说谎包括无意识说谎和有意识说谎，其中大多数是无意识的。这主要和孩子的思维发展水平有关，而主客体不分的思维特点常导致孩子把幻想当成现实，将愿望说成存在。
孩子的心理世界与成人的心理世界有着质的差异，需要客观、理性地理解。

page_text_en:
Teacher Says to You
Child, Actually You Don't Need to Lie
We often say that the world of childhood is a world of truth, goodness, and beauty. But in reality, children's world also contains lies. The difference is that children's lies are very different from adults' lies. Before we explore this difference, let's first read this fairy tale about 'lying'!
Little dog Pipbo felt his life was too dull, so he kept imagining all sorts of things and told everyone as if they were true: On Monday, Pipbo said he was a famous singer; on Tuesday, he claimed to be a great detective; on Wednesday, he said he was as rich as a king; on Thursday, he swore he was a super hero. Pipbo's lies became more and more outrageous, and his classmates finally couldn't stand it anymore, so they designed a 'trap'.
Little dove Delfin, little rabbit Tim, and little cat Charlie all pretended to be in trouble and asked Pipbo for help. Faced with this 'trap' that he couldn't handle, Pipbo burst into tears and had to admit he had indeed lied, but only because he wanted everyone to like him more. Through this incident, Pipbo learned a lesson: his friends loved him for who he truly was, and he didn't need to make up those lies.
Children's lying includes unconscious lying and conscious lying, with most being unconscious. This is mainly related to the child's level of cognitive development, and the characteristic of not distinguishing between self and others often leads children to treat fantasy as reality and wishes as existence.
The psychological world of children differs qualitatively from that of adults and needs to be understood objectively and rationally.

page_text_ocr_zh:
去看待。为了得到旁人的关注，孩子可能时不时地会像小狗皮波那样，以说谎或恶作剧的方式来引人注意。遇到这种情况，作为家长，要注意分析和合理引导孩子的心理需求，积极地与孩子互动。在孩子感到寂寞无助时，要鼓励孩子树立自信心，引导孩子以诚实、开朗的方式与人交往，让孩子相信这个道理：真实的自己才最有魅力！
当我们知道孩子说谎时，应该怎么办呢？首先，要允许孩子申辩，耐心分析孩子说谎的原因和目的。其次，正确地引导孩子认识说谎的坏处，让孩子明白很多事情并不像他想象的那样，不必靠说谎来实现。再次，作为家长，应该以身作则，给孩子树立一个好榜样。最后，希望我们的孩子都能成为诚实守信、言行一致的好孩子！
（全国百佳幼儿园园长 王立华）
page_text_en:
To understand. In order to gain attention from others, children may occasionally act like the little dog Pipbo, using lies or pranks to attract attention. When this happens, parents should pay attention to analyzing and appropriately guiding their children's psychological needs, and actively interacting with them. When children feel lonely and helpless, encourage them to build self-confidence, guide them to interact with others honestly and cheerfully, and help them believe this truth: the real self is the most charming!
What should we do when we know a child is lying? First, allow the child to explain themselves, and patiently analyze the reasons and purposes behind their lies. Second, correctly guide the child to understand the negative consequences of lying, helping them realize that many things are not as they imagine, and that they don't need to rely on lies to achieve their goals. Third, as parents, we should set a good example by leading by example. Finally, we hope all our children can become honest, trustworthy, and consistent good children!
(National Top 100 Kindergarten Principal, Wang Lihua)
